name: example-madera

shots.onScreen: a tilted macOS-style app window titled 'New Agent' (traffic-light dots, a sidebar with Search/Suggestions and a staggered Chats list of about 13 prior requests, a user profile at the bottom); a prompt bar with a blue 'Ask' tag types 'Help me find a new paper lamp' letter by letter, each letter flashing a colour before settling to ink, then a hand cursor rises to the send button and clicks it
shots.moves: camera does one continuous dolly-in/focus-rack the whole shot: blurred and tilted at 0s, sharp and closer by 4.54s, panning right as it goes; the sidebar list staggers in row by row; the prompt text types with a per-letter colour flash; the send button turns green on the click
shots.trigger: the film opens already in motion (no prior joint)

shots.onScreen: the window has shrunk to a small green 'sent' pulse and motion-blurs away; 'MADERA' and 'understands' begin entering from the right
shots.moves: the sent window exits left/shrinks with heavy motion blur while the tagline's first two words slide in from the right, each its own colour
shots.trigger: the send button click fires the exit

shots.onScreen: 'MADERA understands your taste.' finishes entering word by word and settles; 'taste.' keeps its blue accent colour while the rest goes dark ink; faint grey triangle/square/circle shapes drift behind
shots.moves: static camera hold once the words land; only the background shapes drift slowly; the accent word 'taste.' desaturates to ink last

shots.onScreen: the settled tagline drifts left and exits with motion blur; a swipe card (a room-interior photo, Pass/Like buttons) enters from the bottom-right
shots.moves: the tagline exits left with heavy motion blur while the first swipe card slides in from the right, ground beginning to tint pale blue-grey
shots.trigger: the tagline finishes its hold and is pushed out by the next act arriving

shots.onScreen: a stack of three swipe cards (blue-grey room, warm leather living room, Japandi wood room) is dragged left one at a time by a hand cursor pressing each 'Like' button, which recolours to match the photo (teal, olive, red); the ground crossfades to match each card
shots.moves: a slight continuous camera push on the card stack; each card exits left with motion blur as the next enters from the right, three times, the ground re-tinting with each swap
shots.trigger: the hand cursor's presses on 'Like' cause each card's exit

shots.onScreen: the third card exits left with motion blur, the brick-red ground fading back toward light grey; 'MADERA' and 'find' begin entering from the right for the second tagline
shots.moves: the last card's exit motion-blur overlaps the next tagline's first words sliding in from the right
shots.trigger: the last card is dragged out of frame

shots.onScreen: 'MADERA find items you love.' finishes entering word by word and settles; 'love.' keeps its red accent colour while the rest goes dark ink; the same faint shapes drift behind
shots.moves: static camera hold once the words land; background shapes drift; 'love.' desaturates to ink last, then the whole line begins to blur
shots.trigger: the second tagline's own entrance completes

shots.onScreen: the second tagline exits straight up with heavy motion blur; a tilted results window begins rising from the bottom of frame, its heading starting to type 'Japandi and Modern Paper...'
shots.moves: the tagline exits UP (axis change from the acts before it) while the results window rises on y from below, overlapping
shots.trigger: the tagline finishes its hold and is pushed upward by the next act arriving

shots.onScreen: the results window's heading finishes typing 'Japandi and Modern Paper Lamps' while a 3x2 grid of captioned lamp photos fills in beneath it
shots.moves: a slow continuous camera dolly-in on the window as its heading types and the grid fills in tile by tile
shots.trigger: the window reaches its risen position and the heading starts typing

shots.onScreen: the full results window holds briefly, then rises straight up and exits with motion blur, ground fading from olive to light grey; small coloured marks (a blue triangle, red squares, a green dot, a tan square) fly in and assemble letter by letter into the bold 'MADERA' wordmark, which holds centred to the end
shots.moves: the window exits UP with motion blur; the marks fly in from scattered positions and land as letterforms one at a time; camera holds static once the wordmark lands
shots.trigger: the results window's hold ends and it is pushed upward; the wordmark assembly is the film's closing beat, no further joint

groundPattern: light → light → light → light → mid → light → light → light → light → light
